scoring_notes: Dispensing: highest dispensing employee within the selected hospital/period = 100%; others are proportional. Employees with zero dispensing are N/A for this component and are not penalized.
Patient Safety Hold: highest Hold count within the selected hospital/period = 100%; others are proportional. Hold is treated as a positive patient-safety activity.
STAT: compliance is based on STAT orders completed within 30 minutes. Minimum 10 STAT orders for inclusion; otherwise N/A and weight is redistributed.
Clinical: only intervention count is used. Highest intervention count within the selected hospital/period = 100%; acceptance rate is not used.
Inventory: highest request count within the selected hospital/period = 100%; every movement/transaction counts as one request.
Missing/N/A components are excluded and their weight is redistributed across available components.

Regular Staff / Management.Dispensing Method: Each pharmacy is scored separately against the top performer in that same hospital and pharmacy. The employee's pharmacy scores are then weighted by the employee's own workload share in each pharmacy.

Clinical.Method: Highest intervention count among Clinical pharmacists in the same hospital = 100%.

Inventory.Method: Highest request count among Inventory staff in the same hospital = 100%.
